manufacturer.en: Hainan World Electronic Science And Technology Co., Ltd.
manufacturer.zh: 海南世电科技有限公司

description.en: All-in-one weather monitoring station with wind speed, direction, rainfall, and solar radiation sensors. Supports 4G and LoRa data transmission with IP67 housing.
description.zh: 一体化气象监测站，集成风速、风向、雨量、太阳辐射等传感器，支持4G和LoRa数据传输，IP67防护等级。

lead.en: A professional-grade weather station for precision agriculture, meteorology, and environmental monitoring. Measures wind speed, wind direction, rainfall, temperature, humidity, barometric pressure, and solar radiation with high-accuracy sensors.
lead.zh: 一款专业级气象站，适用于精准农业、气象和环境监测。采用高精度传感器测量风速、风向、雨量、温度、湿度、气压和太阳辐射。

product.og_description: All-in-one weather station with 7 environmental sensors and dual 4G/LoRa connectivity.

text.en: Wind speed, wind direction, rainfall, temperature, humidity, barometric pressure, and solar radiation all in a single compact station.
text.zh: 风速、风向、雨量、温度、湿度、气压和太阳辐射，全部集成在一台紧凑型气象站中。

text.en: Connect via 4G LTE (MQTT/HTTP) or LoRa up to 5km range. Choose your preferred backhaul for any deployment location.
text.zh: 通过4G LTE（MQTT/HTTP）或LoRa（最远5km）连接，根据部署位置灵活选择通信方式。

text.en: Built-in 20W solar panel with 12,000mAh backup battery for true off-grid operation, 365 days a year.
text.zh: 内置20W太阳能板和12000mAh备用电池，真正实现离网运行，全年365天不间断。

text.en: IP67-rated enclosure with UV-resistant coating. Operates reliably from -40°C to +85°C in extreme environments.
text.zh: IP67防护外壳，UV防紫外涂层，在-40°C至+85°C的极端环境下可靠运行。

text.en: Integrated GPS/GLONASS/BDS for automatic geo-tagging of weather data across distributed sensor networks.
text.zh: 集成GPS/GLONASS/BDS，在分布式传感器网络中自动为气象数据添加地理标签。

text.en: WEST Cloud dashboard with real-time charts, alerts via email/SMS, and API access for third-party integration.
text.zh: WEST云平台仪表盘，支持实时图表、邮件/SMS告警和第三方API集成。

text.en: Real-time microclimate monitoring for crop management. Optimize irrigation scheduling based on evapotranspiration data and wind conditions.
text.zh: 实时微气候监测，辅助作物管理。基于蒸散数据和风向条件优化灌溉调度。

text.en: Deploy dense networks of weather stations for hyper-local forecasting. LoRa backhaul enables wide-area coverage with low power consumption.
text.zh: 部署密集气象站网络，实现超本地化预报。LoRa回传实现低功耗广域覆盖。
